scope: Finite paired greedy token diagnostics; not representative accuracy, throughput, or MTP Tier 2

cases.name: integer-boundary
cases.prompt: Compute 1001 minus 997. Return only the integer.

cases.name: nested-json
cases.prompt: Return JSON only: an object with key inventory containing two objects: sku A with count 2 and sku B with count 0.

cases.name: string-json
cases.prompt: Return a JSON array containing the strings cafe, resume, and naive, in that order. Do not add commentary.

cases.name: python-empty
cases.prompt: Write a Python function first_or_none(items) that returns the first item, or None when the list is empty. Use no imports.

cases.name: python-ties
cases.prompt: Write a Python function that returns the first index of the largest number in a nonempty list. Ties must keep the first index.

cases.name: boolean-logic
cases.prompt: All amber keys are metal. No metal keys float. Is it possible that an amber key floats? Explain in one sentence.

cases.name: exact-format
cases.prompt: Output exactly three lines: north, east, south. No bullets, numbering, or explanation.

cases.name: ordered-retrieval
cases.prompt: Schedule: Aspen 07:45; Birch 08:20; Cedar 09:05. Which departure is immediately after Aspen? Answer with the name and time.

cases.name: span-retrieval
cases.prompt: Records: ID 41 color blue; ID 42 color amber; ID 43 color green. Return the color for ID 42 only.
